title: [FS] Prevent duplicate Field Service customer assets during item synchronization
summary: Field Service Integration now prevents duplicate Customer Assets by setting Products synchronized from Business Central Items to not convert to Customer Assets, keeping BC as the source of truth for Customer Asset creation.
key_points: Products synchronized from BC Items get Convert to Customer Asset set to No
The default ITEM-PRODUCT mapping gets an outbound constant false mapping for Convert to Customer Asset
Existing coupled Products are changed to No on sync, even when the mapping does not contain the new field yet
The Product flag no longer filters Service Items out of Customer Asset synchronization
Tests added for runtime enforcement and mapping configuration
quote: Setting Convert to Customer Asset to No for Products synchronized from BC Items.
